# Architecture & conventions

`elm-naive-ui` rebuilds [Naive UI](https://www.naiveui.com) components on top of
[elm-ui](https://package.elm-lang.org/packages/mdgriffith/elm-ui/latest/), aiming for
the **same display effect** as the original.

## How fidelity is achieved

Naive UI styles a component from two inputs:

1. **Static structure CSS** — BEM rules like `.n-button { display:inline-flex; … }`,
   including `:hover` / `:focus` / `:active` / `:disabled` states and transitions.
2. **Themed values** — inline `--n-*` CSS custom properties, derived from the theme
   (`self(commonVars)` in Naive UI).

This project reproduces both, so what the browser renders is Naive UI's own CSS:

- `css/naive-ui.css` (and the embedded `NUI.Css.Generated`) contains Naive UI's **exact**
  CSS, generated from its `cssr` sources by `tools/` — not hand-written.
- Each component attaches the same BEM classes **and** an inline `style` carrying the
  same `--n-*` custom properties, computed in Elm from `NUI.Theme.<Comp>.vars`.

### Beating elm-ui's own classes

elm-ui renders elements with helper classes (`.s`, `.s.r`, `.s.e`, `.ui`, `.hc`, …) that
declare `display`, `flex-direction`, `flex-basis`, `white-space`, `padding`, `color`, …
This would fight Naive UI's rules. Two mechanisms resolve it:

- Every generated Naive UI rule is scoped under `.nui-root.nui-root ` (two identical
  class selectors) so it always out-specifies elm-ui's class rules. The app root must
  therefore carry the `nui-root` class — `NUI.Css.layout` adds it, and `NUI.Css.element`
  renders the stylesheet node.
- `tools/bridge.css` restores browser defaults for the two properties Naive UI does
  **not** declare but elm-ui changes: `flex-basis` and `white-space`.

**Do not edit `css/naive-ui.css`, `src/NUI/Css/Generated.elm`, or `tools/bridge.css`
per-component.** If a component needs an extra bridge rule, note it in the PR/task
summary so it can be added centrally.

## Module layout

```
src/
  NUI/Types.elm            Kind, Size (public enums) + kindClass/sizeClass
  NUI/Internal.elm         classes / classIf / cssVars helpers
  NUI/Css.elm              stylesheet + `layout` / `rootAttribute`
  NUI/Css/Generated.elm    GENERATED — do not edit
  NUI/Theme.elm            Theme = { mode, common }, default/dark/setPrimary
  NUI/Theme/Common.elm     GENERATED — common vars (light/dark)
  NUI/Theme/<Comp>.elm     GENERATED — component vars: `vars : Theme -> Vars`
  NUI/<Comp>.elm           the component
```

Generated theme modules map each component variable either to a `common` field (so theme
overrides propagate) or to a literal. Regenerate everything with `cd tools && npm run extract`.

## Component conventions

Model each component on `src/NUI/Button.elm`.

- **API**: an `Options msg` record plus `defaults : Options msg` and
  `view : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg`.

  ```elm
  NUI.Button.view theme { NUI.Button.defaults | kind = T.Primary } [ Element.text "Ok" ]
  ```

- **Theme vars**: `NUI.Theme.<Comp>.vars theme` gives the component's `Vars`; read the
  exact fields Naive UI's `cssVars` uses. Port that logic faithfully from
  `src/<comp>/src/<Comp>.tsx` (`cssVarsRef`) — do not invent values.
- **Classes**: copy the class list from the original `render()` (e.g.
  `.n-button--{size}-type`), including ones not present in the CSS — they cost nothing
  and keep parity with other components / button groups.
- **Root element**: use `Element.row` for row-like roots (Naive UI sets `display` itself,
  which wins; `flex-direction: row` then comes from elm-ui) — see `NUI.Button`. Use
  `Element.el` only when a column root is intended.
- **Attach** `NUI.Internal.classes [...]` and `NUI.Internal.cssVars [...]` (the latter
  drops `initial` values, matching Naive UI's "unset" marker).
- **Interactive elements**: `onPress : Maybe msg` → add `role="button"`, `tabindex 0`
  and `Element.Events.onClick`. Naive UI uses a real `<button>`; a styled `<div>` renders
  identically because `.n-button` sets all button-reset properties itself.
- **Icons**: render Naive UI's `__icon` / `__border` / `__state-border` wrapper elements
  so the CSS applies.

## Reference source (read-only)

The Naive UI checkout is at `/home/titan/Works/elm/naive-ui` (override with
`NAIVE_UI_SRC`). Per component:

```
src/<comp>/src/<Comp>.tsx          implementation + cssVars
src/<comp>/src/styles/*.cssr.ts    structure CSS (already extracted)
src/<comp>/styles/light.ts         theme var derivations (`self`)
src/<comp>/src/public-types.ts     props
src/<comp>/demos/enUS/*.md         usage examples
```

## Building & verifying

```bash
# library
ELM_HOME=/tmp/elm-home elm make

# example page
cd examples && ELM_HOME=/tmp/elm-home elm make src/Main.elm --output=index.html

# DOM/style inspection (jsdom implements the CSS cascade)
node tools/verify/jsdom-inspect.mjs examples/index.html .n-button
```

`ELM_HOME` must point at a directory with the packages pre-installed; see
`scripts/install-elm-packages.sh` (github.com is blocked in this sandbox; packages are
fetched from `codeload.github.com`).

module NUI.Button exposing
    ( IconPlacement(..)
    , Options
    , Variant(..)
    , defaults
    , view
    )

{-| Naive UI's `Button`, rebuilt on elm-ui.

    NUI.Button.view theme NUI.Button.defaults
        [ Element.text "Default" ]

    NUI.Button.view theme
        { NUI.Button.defaults | kind = NUI.Button.Primary }
        [ Element.text "Primary" ]

The visual result is Naive UI's own: the element carries the `.n-button` BEM classes
and Naive UI's `--n-*` custom properties, and `NUI.Css` ships Naive UI's exact CSS.

-}

import Element exposing (Element)
import Element.Events as Events
import Html.Attributes as HA
import NUI.Internal as I
import NUI.Theme exposing (Theme)
import NUI.Theme.Button as ButtonTheme
import NUI.Theme.Color as Color
import NUI.Types as T exposing (Kind(..), Size(..))


type Variant
    = Filled
    | Secondary
    | Tertiary
    | Quaternary
    | Text


type IconPlacement
    = IconLeft
    | IconRight


type alias Options msg =
    { kind : Kind
    , size : Size
    , variant : Variant
    , ghost : Bool
    , dashed : Bool
    , round : Bool
    , circle : Bool
    , block : Bool
    , disabled : Bool
    , loading : Bool
    , strong : Bool
    , bordered : Bool
    , color : Maybe String
    , textColor : Maybe String
    , icon : Maybe (Element msg)
    , iconPlacement : IconPlacement
    , onPress : Maybe msg
    }


defaults : Options msg
defaults =
    { kind = Default
    , size = Medium
    , variant = Filled
    , ghost = False
    , dashed = False
    , round = False
    , circle = False
    , block = False
    , disabled = False
    , loading = False
    , strong = False
    , bordered = True
    , color = Nothing
    , textColor = Nothing
    , icon = Nothing
    , iconPlacement = IconLeft
    , onPress = Nothing
    }


view : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
view theme opts children =
    let
        v =
            ButtonTheme.vars theme

        isText =
            opts.variant == Text

        showBorder =
            not (List.member opts.variant [ Quaternary, Tertiary, Secondary, Text ])
                && (opts.color == Nothing || opts.ghost || opts.dashed)
                && opts.bordered

        content =
            Element.el [ I.classes [ "n-button__content" ] ] (Element.column [] children)

        iconEl =
            case opts.icon of
                Just ic ->
                    Just (Element.el [ I.classes [ "n-button__icon" ] ] ic)

                Nothing ->
                    Nothing

        body =
            case opts.iconPlacement of
                IconRight ->
                    content :: List.filterMap identity [ iconEl ]

                IconLeft ->
                    List.filterMap identity [ iconEl ] ++ [ content ]

        borderEls =
            if showBorder then
                [ Element.el
                    [ I.classes [ "n-button__border" ]
                    , I.cssVars (customColorVars opts.color)
                    ]
                    Element.none
                , Element.el
                    [ I.classes [ "n-button__state-border" ]
                    , I.cssVars (customColorVars opts.color)
                    ]
                    Element.none
                ]

            else
                []

        classes =
            List.concat
                [ [ "n-button"
                  , "n-button--" ++ T.kindClass opts.kind ++ "-type"
                  , "n-button--" ++ T.sizeClass opts.size ++ "-type"
                  ]
                , I.classIf opts.disabled "n-button--disabled"
                , I.classIf opts.block "n-button--block"
                , I.classIf (opts.dashed && not isText) "n-button--dashed"
                , I.classIf (opts.color /= Nothing) "n-button--color"
                , I.classIf (opts.variant == Secondary) "n-button--secondary"
                , I.classIf opts.loading "n-button--loading"
                , I.classIf opts.ghost "n-button--ghost"
                ]

        interactive =
            if opts.disabled || opts.loading then
                [ Element.htmlAttribute (HA.attribute "aria-disabled" "true") ]

            else
                [ Element.htmlAttribute (HA.attribute "role" "button")
                , Element.htmlAttribute (HA.tabindex 0)
                ]
                    ++ (case opts.onPress of
                            Just msg ->
                                [ Events.onClick msg ]

                            Nothing ->
                                []
                       )
    in
    Element.row
        (I.classes classes
            :: I.cssVars (cssVars theme opts v)
            :: interactive
        )
        (body ++ borderEls)


cssVars : Theme -> Options msg -> ButtonTheme.Vars -> List ( String, String )
cssVars theme opts v =
    let
        common =
            theme.common

        isText =
            opts.variant == Text

        cs =
            colorSet opts.kind v

        height =
            heightOf opts.size v

        fontSize =
            fontSizeOf opts.size v

        padding =
            paddingOf opts.size v

        paddingRound =
            paddingRoundOf opts.size v

        iconSize =
            iconSizeOf opts.size v

        borderRadius =
            borderRadiusOf opts.size v

        iconMargin =
            iconMarginOf opts.size v

        custom =
            opts.color

        customText =
            opts.textColor

        fontVars =
            [ ( "--n-font-weight"
              , if opts.strong then
                    v.fontWeightStrong

                else
                    v.fontWeight
              )
            ]

        colorVars =
            if opts.variant == Text then
                let
                    base =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorText custom

                    hover =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextHover custom
                in
                [ ( "--n-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-text-color", base )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", hover )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextPressed custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", hover )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextDisabled custom )
                ]

            else if opts.ghost || opts.dashed then
                let
                    base =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhost custom
                in
                [ ( "--n-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-ripple-color", Maybe.withDefault cs.rippleColor custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color", base )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostHover custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostPressed custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostHover custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostDisabled custom )
                ]

            else if opts.variant == Secondary then
                let
                    isColored =
                        opts.kind /= Default

                    typeText =
                        case opts.kind of
                            Default ->
                                v.textColor

                            _ ->
                                cs.color

                    merged =
                        Maybe.withDefault typeText custom

                    colored alpha =
                        Color.changeColor merged alpha
                in
                [ ( "--n-color"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondary |> Maybe.withDefault 0.16)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondary
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-hover"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondaryHover |> Maybe.withDefault 0.22)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondaryHover
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-pressed"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondaryPressed |> Maybe.withDefault 0.28)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondaryPressed
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorSecondaryHover )
                , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorSecondary )
                , ( "--n-ripple-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-text-color", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", merged )
                ]

            else if opts.variant == Tertiary || opts.variant == Quaternary then
                let
                    typeColor =
                        case opts.kind of
                            Default ->
                                v.textColor

                            _ ->
                                cs.color

                    merged =
                        Maybe.withDefault typeColor custom

                    colorVars_ =
                        if opts.variant == Tertiary then
                            [ ( "--n-color", v.colorTertiary )
                            , ( "--n-color-hover", v.colorTertiaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-pressed", v.colorTertiaryPressed )
                            , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorSecondaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorTertiary )
                            ]

                        else
                            [ ( "--n-color", v.colorQuaternary )
                            , ( "--n-color-hover", v.colorQuaternaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-pressed", v.colorQuaternaryPressed )
                            , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorQuaternaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorQuaternary )
                            ]
                in
                colorVars_
                    ++ [ ( "--n-ripple-color", "#0000" )
                       , ( "--n-text-color", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-hover", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-focus", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", merged )
                       ]

            else
                [ ( "--n-color", Maybe.withDefault cs.color custom )

    , ( "--n-ripple-duration", v.rippleDuration )

module NUI.Button exposing
    ( IconPlacement(..)
    , Options
    , Variant(..)
    , defaults
    , view
    )

{-| Naive UI's `Button`, rebuilt on elm-ui.

    NUI.Button.view theme NUI.Button.defaults
        [ Element.text "Default" ]

    NUI.Button.view theme
        { NUI.Button.defaults | kind = NUI.Button.Primary }
        [ Element.text "Primary" ]

The visual result is Naive UI's own: the element carries the `.n-button` BEM classes
and Naive UI's `--n-*` custom properties, and `NUI.Css` ships Naive UI's exact CSS.

-}

import Element exposing (Element)
import Element.Events as Events
import Html.Attributes as HA
import NUI.Internal as I
import NUI.Theme exposing (Theme)
import NUI.Theme.Button as ButtonTheme
import NUI.Theme.Color as Color
import NUI.Types as T exposing (Kind(..), Size(..))


type Variant
    = Filled
    | Secondary
    | Tertiary
    | Quaternary
    | Text


type IconPlacement
    = IconLeft
    | IconRight


type alias Options msg =
    { kind : Kind
    , size : Size
    , variant : Variant
    , ghost : Bool
    , dashed : Bool
    , round : Bool
    , circle : Bool
    , block : Bool
    , disabled : Bool
    , loading : Bool
    , strong : Bool
    , bordered : Bool
    , color : Maybe String
    , textColor : Maybe String
    , icon : Maybe (Element msg)
    , iconPlacement : IconPlacement
    , onPress : Maybe msg
    }


defaults : Options msg
defaults =
    { kind = Default
    , size = Medium
    , variant = Filled
    , ghost = False
    , dashed = False
    , round = False
    , circle = False
    , block = False
    , disabled = False
    , loading = False
    , strong = False
    , bordered = True
    , color = Nothing
    , textColor = Nothing
    , icon = Nothing
    , iconPlacement = IconLeft
    , onPress = Nothing
    }


view : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
view theme opts children =
    let
        v =
            ButtonTheme.vars theme

        isText =
            opts.variant == Text

        showBorder =
            not (List.member opts.variant [ Quaternary, Tertiary, Secondary, Text ])
                && (opts.color == Nothing || opts.ghost || opts.dashed)
                && opts.bordered

        content =
            Element.el [ I.classes [ "n-button__content" ] ] (Element.column [] children)

        iconEl =
            case opts.icon of
                Just ic ->
                    Just (Element.el [ I.classes [ "n-button__icon" ] ] ic)

                Nothing ->
                    Nothing

        body =
            case opts.iconPlacement of
                IconRight ->
                    content :: List.filterMap identity [ iconEl ]

                IconLeft ->
                    List.filterMap identity [ iconEl ] ++ [ content ]

        borderEls =
            if showBorder then
                [ Element.el
                    [ I.classes [ "n-button__border" ]
                    , I.cssVars (customColorVars opts.color)
                    ]
                    Element.none
                , Element.el
                    [ I.classes [ "n-button__state-border" ]
                    , I.cssVars (customColorVars opts.color)
                    ]
                    Element.none
                ]

            else
                []

        classes =
            List.concat
                [ [ "n-button"
                  , "n-button--" ++ T.kindClass opts.kind ++ "-type"
                  , "n-button--" ++ T.sizeClass opts.size ++ "-type"
                  ]
                , I.classIf opts.disabled "n-button--disabled"
                , I.classIf opts.block "n-button--block"
                , I.classIf (opts.dashed && not isText) "n-button--dashed"
                , I.classIf (opts.color /= Nothing) "n-button--color"
                , I.classIf (opts.variant == Secondary) "n-button--secondary"
                , I.classIf opts.loading "n-button--loading"
                , I.classIf opts.ghost "n-button--ghost"
                ]

        interactive =
            if opts.disabled || opts.loading then
                [ Element.htmlAttribute (HA.attribute "aria-disabled" "true") ]

            else
                [ Element.htmlAttribute (HA.attribute "role" "button")
                , Element.htmlAttribute (HA.tabindex 0)
                ]
                    ++ (case opts.onPress of
                            Just msg ->
                                [ Events.onClick msg ]

                            Nothing ->
                                []
                       )
    in
    Element.row
        (I.classes classes
            :: I.cssVars (cssVars theme opts v)
            :: interactive
        )
        (body ++ borderEls)


cssVars : Theme -> Options msg -> ButtonTheme.Vars -> List ( String, String )
cssVars theme opts v =
    let
        common =
            theme.common

        isText =
            opts.variant == Text

        cs =
            colorSet opts.kind v

        height =
            heightOf opts.size v

        fontSize =
            fontSizeOf opts.size v

        padding =
            paddingOf opts.size v

        paddingRound =
            paddingRoundOf opts.size v

        iconSize =
            iconSizeOf opts.size v

        borderRadius =
            borderRadiusOf opts.size v

        iconMargin =
            iconMarginOf opts.size v

        custom =
            opts.color

        customText =
            opts.textColor

        fontVars =
            [ ( "--n-font-weight"
              , if opts.strong then
                    v.fontWeightStrong

                else
                    v.fontWeight
              )
            ]

        colorVars =
            if opts.variant == Text then
                let
                    base =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorText custom

                    hover =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextHover custom
                in
                [ ( "--n-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-text-color", base )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", hover )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextPressed custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", hover )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextDisabled custom )
                ]

            else if opts.ghost || opts.dashed then
                let
                    base =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhost custom
                in
                [ ( "--n-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-ripple-color", Maybe.withDefault cs.rippleColor custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color", base )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostHover custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostPressed custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostHover custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostDisabled custom )
                ]

            else if opts.variant == Secondary then
                let
                    isColored =
                        opts.kind /= Default

                    typeText =
                        case opts.kind of
                            Default ->
                                v.textColor

                            _ ->
                                cs.color

                    merged =
                        Maybe.withDefault typeText custom

                    colored alpha =
                        Color.changeColor merged alpha
                in
                [ ( "--n-color"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondary |> Maybe.withDefault 0.16)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondary
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-hover"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondaryHover |> Maybe.withDefault 0.22)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondaryHover
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-pressed"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondaryPressed |> Maybe.withDefault 0.28)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondaryPressed
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorSecondaryHover )
                , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorSecondary )
                , ( "--n-ripple-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-text-color", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", merged )
                ]

            else if opts.variant == Tertiary || opts.variant == Quaternary then
                let
                    typeColor =
                        case opts.kind of
                            Default ->
                                v.textColor

                            _ ->
                                cs.color

                    merged =
                        Maybe.withDefault typeColor custom

                    colorVars_ =
                        if opts.variant == Tertiary then
                            [ ( "--n-color", v.colorTertiary )
                            , ( "--n-color-hover", v.colorTertiaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-pressed", v.colorTertiaryPressed )
                            , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorSecondaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorTertiary )
                            ]

                        else
                            [ ( "--n-color", v.colorQuaternary )
                            , ( "--n-color-hover", v.colorQuaternaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-pressed", v.colorQuaternaryPressed )
                            , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorQuaternaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorQuaternary )
                            ]
                in
                colorVars_
                    ++ [ ( "--n-ripple-color", "#0000" )
                       , ( "--n-text-color", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-hover", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-focus", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", merged )
                       ]

            else
                [ ( "--n-color", Maybe.withDefault cs.color custom )
                , ( "--n-color-hover"
                  , Maybe.withDefault cs.colorHover (Maybe.map Color.createHoverColor custom)
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-pressed"
                  , Maybe.withDefault cs.colorPressed (Maybe.map Color.createPressedColor custom)
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-focus"
                  , Maybe.withDefault cs.colorFocus (Maybe.map Color.createHoverColor custom)
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-disabled", Maybe.withDefault cs.colorDisabled custom )
                , ( "--n-ripple-color", Maybe.withDefault cs.rippleColor custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColor
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorHoverPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColorHover
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorPressedPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColorPressed
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorFocusPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColorFocus
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorDisabledPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColorDisabled
                            )
                  )
                ]

        borderVars =
            if opts.variant == Text then
                [ ( "--n-border", "none" )
                , ( "--n-border-hover", "none" )
                , ( "--n-border-pressed", "none" )
                , ( "--n-border-focus", "none" )
                , ( "--n-border-disabled", "none" )
                ]

            else
                [ ( "--n-border", cs.border )
                , ( "--n-border-hover", cs.borderHover )
                , ( "--n-border-pressed", cs.borderPressed )
                , ( "--n-border-focus", cs.borderFocus )
                , ( "--n-border-disabled", cs.borderDisabled )
                ]

        sizeVars =
            [ ( "--n-width"
              , if opts.circle && not isText then
                    height

                else
                    "initial"
              )
            , ( "--n-height"
              , if isText then
                    "initial"

                else
                    height
              )
            , ( "--n-font-size", fontSize )
            , ( "--n-padding"
              , if opts.circle then
                    "initial"

                else if isText then
                    "initial"

                else if opts.round then
                    paddingRound

                else
                    padding
              )
            , ( "--n-icon-size", iconSize )
            , ( "--n-icon-margin", iconMargin )
            , ( "--n-border-radius"

module NUI.Internal exposing (classIf, classes, cssVars)

{-| Small shared helpers used by every component.

Naive UI styles every component from two inputs:

1.  BEM class names on the element (`.n-button.n-button--primary`), which carry the
    static structure rules from `css/naive-ui.css`.
2.  `--n-*` CSS custom properties, which carry the themed values. Naive UI emits
    these as an inline `style` attribute; so do we.

Both are attached to elm-ui elements via `Element.htmlAttribute`.

-}

import Element exposing (Attribute)
import Html.Attributes as HA


{-| `classIf True "x" == [ "x" ]`, `classIf False "x" == []`. Compose a class list
with `List.concat`.
-}
classIf : Bool -> String -> List String
classIf cond c =
    if cond then
        [ c ]

    else
        []


classes : List String -> Attribute msg
classes =
    Element.htmlAttribute << HA.class << String.join " "


{-| Attach an inline `style` attribute built from `--n-*` custom properties.
`initial` values (Naive UI's "unset" marker) are dropped.
-}
cssVars : List ( String, String ) -> Attribute msg
cssVars vars =
    Element.htmlAttribute (HA.attribute "style" (renderVars vars))


renderVars : List ( String, String ) -> String
renderVars vars =
    vars
        |> List.filter (\( _, v ) -> v /= "initial" && not (String.isEmpty v))
        |> List.map (\( k, v ) -> k ++ ":" ++ v)
        |> String.join ";"

            "info"

            "success"

module NUI.Css exposing
    ( css
    , element
    , layout
    , rootAttribute
    )

{-| Ships Naive UI's stylesheet and the scope marker it relies on.

The CSS is generated from Naive UI's own cssr sources (see `tools/`) and embedded so
the package is self-contained — no separate `.css` import needed. Every rule is
scoped under `.nui-root`, so an ancestor element must carry the marker class.
`layout` (drop-in for `Element.layout`) sets it for you, and `element` renders the
stylesheet node.

    view model =
        NUI.Css.layout []
            (Element.column [ spacing 16 ]
                [ NUI.Css.element
                , NUI.Button.view theme NUI.Button.defaults [ Element.text "Hello" ]
                ]
            )

-}

import Element exposing (Attribute, Element)
import Html
import Html.Attributes as HA
import NUI.Css.Generated as Generated


{-| The full stylesheet as a string (for a `<link>`/inline `<style>` approach).
-}
css : String
css =
    Generated.all


{-| A `<style>` node. Include it once near the root of your app.
-}
element : Element msg
element =
    Element.html (Html.node "style" [] [ Html.text css ])


{-| The class the generated stylesheet is scoped under. Add it to (an ancestor of)
your components.
-}
rootAttribute : Attribute msg
rootAttribute =
    Element.htmlAttribute (HA.class "nui-root")


{-| Drop-in replacement for `Element.layout` that adds `rootAttribute`.
-}
layout : List (Attribute msg) -> Element msg -> Html.Html msg
layout attrs content =
    Element.layout (rootAttribute :: attrs) content

module NUI.Typography exposing
    ( FontAlign(..)
    , Options
    , a
    , blockquote
    , defaults
    , h1
    , h2
    , h3
    , h4
    , h5
    , h6
    , hr
    , li
    , ol
    , p
    , text
    , ul
    )

{-| Naive UI's `Typography` component set, rebuilt on elm-ui.

Every element carries the same BEM classes and the same `--n-*` custom properties
Naive UI emits, so with `NUI.Css` in scope it renders using Naive UI's own CSS.

    NUI.Typography.h1 theme NUI.Typography.defaults
        [ Element.text "Wonderful" ]

    NUI.Typography.text theme
        { NUI.Typography.defaults | kind = T.Primary, strong = True }
        [ Element.text "primary and strong" ]

    NUI.Typography.ul theme NUI.Typography.defaults
        [ NUI.Typography.li [ Element.text "First" ]
        , NUI.Typography.li [ Element.text "Second" ]
        ]

One `Options` record covers the whole set (Naive UI threads the same theme props
through every typography component); each element only honours the fields its
Naive UI counterpart has, plus a few elm-side conveniences that Naive UI leaves to
its users (`size`, `align`, `fontWeight`, `href`).

Block-level elements (`h1`-`h6`, `p`, `blockquote`, `ul`, `ol`, `li`, `hr`) are
elm-ui paragraphs — block flow with wrapping inline children. `text` and `a` flow
inline when placed inside a paragraph.

-}

import Element exposing (Element)
import Element.Events as Events
import Html.Attributes as HA
import NUI.Internal as I
import NUI.Theme exposing (Theme)
import NUI.Theme.Typography as ThemeTypography
import NUI.Types as T exposing (Kind(..))



-- Options


{-| Text alignment for the `align` option (`text-align`).
-}
type FontAlign
    = AlignLeft
    | AlignCenter
    | AlignRight
    | AlignJustify


type alias Options msg =
    { kind : Kind
    , depth : Maybe Int
    , strong : Bool
    , italic : Bool
    , underline : Bool
    , delete : Bool
    , code : Bool
    , prefixBar : Bool
    , alignText : Bool
    , size : Maybe Int
    , align : Maybe FontAlign
    , fontWeight : Maybe String
    , href : Maybe String
    , onPress : Maybe msg
    }


defaults : Options msg
defaults =
    { kind = T.Default
    , depth = Nothing
    , strong = False
    , italic = False
    , underline = False
    , delete = False
    , code = False
    , prefixBar = False
    , alignText = False
    , size = Nothing
    , align = Nothing
    , fontWeight = Nothing
    , href = Nothing
    , onPress = Nothing
    }



-- Text


{-| Naive UI's `Text` — `.n-text` on a flow element.

`kind` maps its `type` prop, `depth` (1-3) only applies to the `default` kind,
`strong` / `italic` / `underline` / `code` add the matching `n-text--*` class, and
`delete` strikes the text through (Naive UI renders a `<del>`; we cannot, so the
`text-decoration` is applied inline).
-}
text : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
text theme opts children =
    let
        v =
            ThemeTypography.vars theme

        classes =
            List.concat
                [ [ "n-text" ]
                , I.classIf opts.code "n-text--code"
                , I.classIf opts.delete "n-text--delete"
                , I.classIf opts.strong "n-text--strong"
                , I.classIf opts.italic "n-text--italic"
                , I.classIf opts.underline "n-text--underline"
                ]
    in
    Element.paragraph
        [ I.classes classes
        , I.cssVars (textCssVars theme opts v ++ deleteStyles opts ++ convenienceStyles opts)
        ]
        children


textCssVars : Theme -> Options msg -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> List ( String, String )
textCssVars theme opts v =
    [ ( "--n-bezier", theme.common.cubicBezierEaseInOut )
    , ( "--n-text-color", textColorOf opts.kind opts.depth v )
    , ( "--n-font-weight-strong", theme.common.fontWeightStrong )
    , ( "--n-font-famliy-mono", theme.common.fontFamilyMono )
    , ( "--n-code-border-radius", v.codeBorderRadius )
    , ( "--n-code-text-color", v.codeTextColor )
    , ( "--n-code-color", v.codeColor )
    , ( "--n-code-border", v.codeBorder )
    ]


{-| `type === 'default' ? textColor${depth}Depth : createKey('textColor', type)`.
-}
textColorOf : Kind -> Maybe Int -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> String
textColorOf kind depth v =
    case kind of
        T.Default ->
            case depth of
                Nothing ->
                    v.textColor

                Just d ->
                    if d <= 1 then
                        v.textColor1Depth

                    else if d == 2 then
                        v.textColor2Depth

                    else
                        v.textColor3Depth

        T.Primary ->
            v.textColorPrimary

        T.Info ->
            v.textColorInfo

        T.Success ->
            v.textColorSuccess

        T.Warning ->
            v.textColorWarning

        T.Error ->
            v.textColorError



-- Headers


type HeaderLevel
    = H1
    | H2
    | H3
    | H4
    | H5
    | H6


{-| Naive UI's `H1`-`H6` — `.n-h .n-h{level}`. `kind` selects the prefix-bar
colour, `prefixBar` adds `.n-h--prefix-bar`, `alignText` adds `.n-h--align-text`.
-}
h1 : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
h1 =
    header H1


h2 : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
h2 =
    header H2


h3 : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
h3 =
    header H3


h4 : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
h4 =
    header H4


h5 : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
h5 =
    header H5


h6 : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
h6 =
    header H6


header : HeaderLevel -> Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
header level theme opts children =
    let
        v =
            ThemeTypography.vars theme

        classes =
            List.concat
                [ [ "n-h", "n-h" ++ levelSuffix level ]
                , I.classIf opts.prefixBar "n-h--prefix-bar"
                , I.classIf opts.alignText "n-h--align-text"
                ]

        , I.cssVars (hrCssVars theme v ++ blockDisplay)
        ]
        Element.none


hrCssVars : Theme -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> List ( String, String )
hrCssVars theme v =
    [ ( "--n-bezier", theme.common.cubicBezierEaseInOut )
    , ( "--n-color", v.hrColor )
    ]



-- Lists


{-| Naive UI's `Ul` — `.n-ul` (+ `--align-text`).
-}
ul : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
ul =
    list False


{-| Naive UI's `Ol` — `.n-ol` (+ `--align-text`).
-}
ol : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
ol =
    list True


list : Bool -> Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
list ordered theme opts children =
    let
        v =
            ThemeTypography.vars theme

        base =
            if ordered then
                "n-ol"

            else
                "n-ul"

        classes =
            List.concat
                [ [ base ]
                , I.classIf opts.alignText (base ++ "--align-text")
                ]
    in
    Element.paragraph
        [ I.classes classes
        , I.cssVars (listCssVars theme v ++ uaListStyles ordered ++ convenienceStyles opts)
        ]
        children


listCssVars : Theme -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> List ( String, String )
listCssVars theme v =
    [ ( "--n-bezier", theme.common.cubicBezierEaseInOut )
    , ( "--n-font-size", v.liFontSize )
    , ( "--n-line-height", v.liLineHeight )
    , ( "--n-text-color", v.liTextColor )
    , ( "--n-li-margin", v.liMargin )
    , ( "--n-ol-padding", v.olPadding )
    , ( "--n-ul-padding", v.ulPadding )
    ]


{-| What a native `<ul>` / `<ol>` contributes and Naive UI relies on:
block display, inherited markers, and default block margins. Naive UI styles the
padding (via `--n-*-padding`) itself, markers and margins come from the browser.
-}
uaListStyles : Bool -> List ( String, String )
uaListStyles ordered =
    [ ( "display", "block" )
    , ( "list-style-type"
      , if ordered then
            "decimal"

        else
            "disc"
      )
    , ( "margin-top", "1em" )
    , ( "margin-bottom", "1em" )
    ]


{-| Naive UI's `Li` — a bare `<li>` (no classes, no vars of its own; the styles
come from the `.n-ul li` / `.n-ol li` rules and the vars defined by the
surrounding list). We emit the `n-li` class for parity and restate those
tag-selector rules inline, since our element is not an `<li>` tag.
-}
li : List (Element msg) -> Element msg
li children =
    Element.paragraph
        [ I.classes [ "n-li" ]
        , I.cssVars liStyles
        ]
        children


{-| The `.n-ul li` rule: `transition / line-height / margin / color`, plus the
`display: list-item` and marker a native `<li>` gets from the browser. The
`var(--n-*)` references resolve against the surrounding list's inline vars.
-}
liStyles : List ( String, String )
liStyles =
    [ ( "display", "list-item" )
    , ( "transition", "color .3s var(--n-bezier)" )
    , ( "line-height", "var(--n-line-height)" )
    , ( "margin", "var(--n-li-margin)" )
    , ( "margin-bottom", "0" )
    , ( "color", "var(--n-text-color)" )
    ]



-- Shared style helpers


{-| Keep block-level typography block-level even when nested inside an elm-ui
paragraph (whose `.s.p .s.p { display: inline }` rule would otherwise inline it —
native block tags can never end up inline inside text flow).
-}
blockDisplay : List ( String, String )
blockDisplay =
    [ ( "display", "block" )
    ]


{-| Naive UI's `<del>`: `text-decoration: line-through`. Skipped when
`n-text--underline` is set, mirroring the cascade where the author underline rule
replaces the `<del>`'s user-agent line-through.
-}
deleteStyles : Options msg -> List ( String, String )
deleteStyles opts =
    if opts.delete && not opts.underline then
        [ ( "text-decoration", "line-through" )
        ]

    else
        []


{-| Elm-side conveniences Naive UI does not offer as props: `size` (px),
`fontWeight` (any CSS value) and `align` (`text-align`). Emitted inline so they
win over both elm-ui helper classes and the scoped Naive UI rules.
-}
convenienceStyles : Options msg -> List ( String, String )
convenienceStyles opts =
    List.concat
        [ maybeStyle "font-size" (Maybe.map (\px -> String.fromInt px ++ "px") opts.size)
        , maybeStyle "font-weight" opts.fontWeight
        , maybeStyle "text-align" (Maybe.map alignCss opts.align)
        ]


maybeStyle : String -> Maybe String -> List ( String, String )
maybeStyle prop value =
    case value of
        Just v ->
            [ ( prop, v ) ]

        Nothing ->
            []


alignCss : FontAlign -> String
alignCss align =
    case align of
        AlignLeft ->
            "left"

        AlignCenter ->
            "center"

        AlignRight ->
            "right"

        AlignJustify ->
            "justify"

message.reasoning_content:
Excellent — the vars land, classes land, `n-text--code` gets `display: inline-block` ✓, delete → line-through inline ✓ (and skipped for underline case ✓). Note `--n-text-color: rgb(51, 54, 57)` — that's textColor2 for default kind ✓ matches naive light theme. One thing: jsdom computed values show `color: var(--n-text-color)` (jsdom doesn't resolve vars — fine). Interesting: `width: 100%` — the `wf` class! Element.paragraph gets `width fill`?? Where does `wf` come from? Classes: "spacing-5-5 s p wf n-text". `wf` = widthFill. Hmm — elm-ui's paragraph defaults to width fill! `Element.paragraph` → In elm-ui, `paragraph` sets `width fill` by default? Yes — `Element.paragraph` docs: "the paragraph will fill available width". Actually I recall paragraph defaults to `width fill`. That's GOOD for typography (block elements take full width like native p/h1). Also `spacing-5-5` — hmm? That's from my column spacing 8 → applies to children (spacing class). Fine. lineHeight "calc(1em + 5px)" — elm-ui's default font adjustment... but `.n-p` sets `line-height: var(--n-line-height)` — for `.n-text` there's no line-height rule → inherits elm-ui's calc line-height. Native span inside `

` inherits the p's line-height — in our case the text IS the block so it gets elm-ui default `calc(1em + 5px)` instead of naive's 1.6? Hmm — for `text` used standalone as a block, line-height differs from naive's `1.6`. When used inside `NUI.Typography.p`, it inherits the p's `--n-line-height` ✓. Naive's n-text standalone in a naive page inherits from parent typography. Our elm-ui default is the elm-world normal. Acceptable? Hmm. Should I force line-height on text to match? No — naive doesn't set it on .n-text; inheriting from context is exactly what naive does. In elm-ui context the inherited value is elm-ui's default. That's "correct port behavior" — the context differs. OK. Now check the rest: h2 (prefix-bar), p, a, blockquote, hr, ul/ol/li.

# Architecture & conventions

`elm-naive-ui` rebuilds [Naive UI](https://www.naiveui.com) components on top of
[elm-ui](https://package.elm-lang.org/packages/mdgriffith/elm-ui/latest/), aiming for
the **same display effect** as the original.

## How fidelity is achieved

Naive UI styles a component from two inputs:

1. **Static structure CSS** — BEM rules like `.n-button { display:inline-flex; … }`,
   including `:hover` / `:focus` / `:active` / `:disabled` states and transitions.
2. **Themed values** — inline `--n-*` CSS custom properties, derived from the theme
   (`self(commonVars)` in Naive UI).

This project reproduces both, so what the browser renders is Naive UI's own CSS:

- `css/naive-ui.css` (and the embedded `NUI.Css.Generated`) contains Naive UI's **exact**
  CSS, generated from its `cssr` sources by `tools/` — not hand-written.
- Each component attaches the same BEM classes **and** an inline `style` carrying the
  same `--n-*` custom properties, computed in Elm from `NUI.Theme.<Comp>.vars`.

### Beating elm-ui's own classes

elm-ui renders elements with helper classes (`.s`, `.s.r`, `.s.e`, `.ui`, `.hc`, …) that
declare `display`, `flex-direction`, `flex-basis`, `white-space`, `padding`, `color`, …
This would fight Naive UI's rules. Two mechanisms resolve it:

- Every generated Naive UI rule is scoped under `.nui-root.nui-root ` (two identical
  class selectors) so it always out-specifies elm-ui's class rules. The app root must
  therefore carry the `nui-root` class — `NUI.Css.layout` adds it, and `NUI.Css.element`
  renders the stylesheet node.
- `tools/bridge.css` restores browser defaults for the two properties Naive UI does
  **not** declare but elm-ui changes: `flex-basis` and `white-space`.

**Do not edit `css/naive-ui.css`, `src/NUI/Css/Generated.elm`, or `tools/bridge.css`
per-component.** If a component needs an extra bridge rule, note it in the PR/task
summary so it can be added centrally.

## Module layout

```
src/
  NUI/Types.elm            Kind, Size (public enums) + kindClass/sizeClass
  NUI/Internal.elm         classes / classIf / cssVars helpers
  NUI/Css.elm              stylesheet + `layout` / `rootAttribute`
  NUI/Css/Generated.elm    GENERATED — do not edit
  NUI/Theme.elm            Theme = { mode, common }, default/dark/setPrimary
  NUI/Theme/Common.elm     GENERATED — common vars (light/dark)
  NUI/Theme/<Comp>.elm     GENERATED — component vars: `vars : Theme -> Vars`
  NUI/<Comp>.elm           the component
```

Generated theme modules map each component variable either to a `common` field (so theme
overrides propagate) or to a literal. Regenerate everything with `cd tools && npm run extract`.

## Component conventions

Model each component on `src/NUI/Button.elm`.

- **API**: an `Options msg` record plus `defaults : Options msg` and
  `view : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg`.

  ```elm
  NUI.Button.view theme { NUI.Button.defaults | kind = T.Primary } [ Element.text "Ok" ]
  ```

- **Theme vars**: `NUI.Theme.<Comp>.vars theme` gives the component's `Vars`; read the
  exact fields Naive UI's `cssVars` uses. Port that logic faithfully from
  `src/<comp>/src/<Comp>.tsx` (`cssVarsRef`) — do not invent values.
- **Classes**: copy the class list from the original `render()` (e.g.
  `.n-button--{size}-type`), including ones not present in the CSS — they cost nothing
  and keep parity with other components / button groups.
- **Root element**: use `Element.row` for row-like roots (Naive UI sets `display` itself,
  which wins; `flex-direction: row` then comes from elm-ui) — see `NUI.Button`. Use
  `Element.el` only when a column root is intended.
- **Attach** `NUI.Internal.classes [...]` and `NUI.Internal.cssVars [...]` (the latter
  drops `initial` values, matching Naive UI's "unset" marker).
- **Interactive elements**: `onPress : Maybe msg` → add `role="button"`, `tabindex 0`
  and `Element.Events.onClick`. Naive UI uses a real `<button>`; a styled `<div>` renders
  identically because `.n-button` sets all button-reset properties itself.
- **Icons**: render Naive UI's `__icon` / `__border` / `__state-border` wrapper elements
  so the CSS applies.

## Reference source (read-only)

The Naive UI checkout is at `/home/titan/Works/elm/naive-ui` (override with
`NAIVE_UI_SRC`). Per component:

```
src/<comp>/src/<Comp>.tsx          implementation + cssVars
src/<comp>/src/styles/*.cssr.ts    structure CSS (already extracted)
src/<comp>/styles/light.ts         theme var derivations (`self`)
src/<comp>/src/public-types.ts     props
src/<comp>/demos/enUS/*.md         usage examples
```

## Building & verifying

```bash
# library
ELM_HOME=/tmp/elm-home elm make

# example page
cd examples && ELM_HOME=/tmp/elm-home elm make src/Main.elm --output=index.html

# DOM/style inspection (jsdom implements the CSS cascade)
node tools/verify/jsdom-inspect.mjs examples/index.html .n-button
```

`ELM_HOME` must point at a directory with the packages pre-installed; see
`scripts/install-elm-packages.sh` (github.com is blocked in this sandbox; packages are
fetched from `codeload.github.com`).

module NUI.Button exposing
    ( IconPlacement(..)
    , Options
    , Variant(..)
    , defaults
    , view
    )

{-| Naive UI's `Button`, rebuilt on elm-ui.

    NUI.Button.view theme NUI.Button.defaults
        [ Element.text "Default" ]

    NUI.Button.view theme
        { NUI.Button.defaults | kind = NUI.Button.Primary }
        [ Element.text "Primary" ]

The visual result is Naive UI's own: the element carries the `.n-button` BEM classes
and Naive UI's `--n-*` custom properties, and `NUI.Css` ships Naive UI's exact CSS.

-}

import Element exposing (Element)
import Element.Events as Events
import Html.Attributes as HA
import NUI.Internal as I
import NUI.Theme exposing (Theme)
import NUI.Theme.Button as ButtonTheme
import NUI.Theme.Color as Color
import NUI.Types as T exposing (Kind(..), Size(..))


type Variant
    = Filled
    | Secondary
    | Tertiary
    | Quaternary
    | Text


type IconPlacement
    = IconLeft
    | IconRight


type alias Options msg =
    { kind : Kind
    , size : Size
    , variant : Variant
    , ghost : Bool
    , dashed : Bool
    , round : Bool
    , circle : Bool
    , block : Bool
    , disabled : Bool
    , loading : Bool
    , strong : Bool
    , bordered : Bool
    , color : Maybe String
    , textColor : Maybe String
    , icon : Maybe (Element msg)
    , iconPlacement : IconPlacement
    , onPress : Maybe msg
    }


defaults : Options msg
defaults =
    { kind = Default
    , size = Medium
    , variant = Filled
    , ghost = False
    , dashed = False
    , round = False
    , circle = False
    , block = False
    , disabled = False
    , loading = False
    , strong = False
    , bordered = True
    , color = Nothing
    , textColor = Nothing
    , icon = Nothing
    , iconPlacement = IconLeft
    , onPress = Nothing
    }


view : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
view theme opts children =
    let
        v =
            ButtonTheme.vars theme

        isText =
            opts.variant == Text

        showBorder =
            not (List.member opts.variant [ Quaternary, Tertiary, Secondary, Text ])
                && (opts.color == Nothing || opts.ghost || opts.dashed)
                && opts.bordered

        content =
            Element.el [ I.classes [ "n-button__content" ] ] (Element.column [] children)

        iconEl =
            case opts.icon of
                Just ic ->
                    Just (Element.el [ I.classes [ "n-button__icon" ] ] ic)

                Nothing ->
                    Nothing

        body =
            case opts.iconPlacement of
                IconRight ->
                    content :: List.filterMap identity [ iconEl ]

                IconLeft ->
                    List.filterMap identity [ iconEl ] ++ [ content ]

        borderEls =
            if showBorder then
                [ Element.el
                    [ I.classes [ "n-button__border" ]
                    , I.cssVars (customColorVars opts.color)
                    ]
                    Element.none
                , Element.el
                    [ I.classes [ "n-button__state-border" ]
                    , I.cssVars (customColorVars opts.color)
                    ]
                    Element.none
                ]

            else
                []

        classes =
            List.concat
                [ [ "n-button"
                  , "n-button--" ++ T.kindClass opts.kind ++ "-type"
                  , "n-button--" ++ T.sizeClass opts.size ++ "-type"
                  ]
                , I.classIf opts.disabled "n-button--disabled"
                , I.classIf opts.block "n-button--block"
                , I.classIf (opts.dashed && not isText) "n-button--dashed"
                , I.classIf (opts.color /= Nothing) "n-button--color"
                , I.classIf (opts.variant == Secondary) "n-button--secondary"
                , I.classIf opts.loading "n-button--loading"
                , I.classIf opts.ghost "n-button--ghost"
                ]

        interactive =
            if opts.disabled || opts.loading then
                [ Element.htmlAttribute (HA.attribute "aria-disabled" "true") ]

            else
                [ Element.htmlAttribute (HA.attribute "role" "button")
                , Element.htmlAttribute (HA.tabindex 0)
                ]
                    ++ (case opts.onPress of
                            Just msg ->
                                [ Events.onClick msg ]

                            Nothing ->
                                []
                       )
    in
    Element.row
        (I.classes classes
            :: I.cssVars (cssVars theme opts v)
            :: interactive
        )
        (body ++ borderEls)


cssVars : Theme -> Options msg -> ButtonTheme.Vars -> List ( String, String )
cssVars theme opts v =
    let
        common =
            theme.common

        isText =
            opts.variant == Text

        cs =
            colorSet opts.kind v

        height =
            heightOf opts.size v

        fontSize =
            fontSizeOf opts.size v

        padding =
            paddingOf opts.size v

        paddingRound =
            paddingRoundOf opts.size v

        iconSize =
            iconSizeOf opts.size v

        borderRadius =
            borderRadiusOf opts.size v

        iconMargin =
            iconMarginOf opts.size v

        custom =
            opts.color

        customText =
            opts.textColor

        fontVars =
            [ ( "--n-font-weight"
              , if opts.strong then
                    v.fontWeightStrong

                else
                    v.fontWeight
              )
            ]

        colorVars =
            if opts.variant == Text then
                let
                    base =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorText custom

                    hover =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextHover custom
                in
                [ ( "--n-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-text-color", base )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", hover )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextPressed custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", hover )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextDisabled custom )
                ]

            else if opts.ghost || opts.dashed then
                let
                    base =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhost custom
                in
                [ ( "--n-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-ripple-color", Maybe.withDefault cs.rippleColor custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color", base )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostHover custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostPressed custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostHover custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostDisabled custom )
                ]

            else if opts.variant == Secondary then
                let
                    isColored =
                        opts.kind /= Default

                    typeText =
                        case opts.kind of
                            Default ->
                                v.textColor

                            _ ->
                                cs.color

                    merged =
                        Maybe.withDefault typeText custom

                    colored alpha =
                        Color.changeColor merged alpha
                in
                [ ( "--n-color"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondary |> Maybe.withDefault 0.16)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondary
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-hover"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondaryHover |> Maybe.withDefault 0.22)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondaryHover
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-pressed"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondaryPressed |> Maybe.withDefault 0.28)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondaryPressed
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorSecondaryHover )
                , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorSecondary )
                , ( "--n-ripple-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-text-color", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", merged )
                ]

            else if opts.variant == Tertiary || opts.variant == Quaternary then
                let
                    typeColor =
                        case opts.kind of
                            Default ->
                                v.textColor

                            _ ->
                                cs.color

                    merged =
                        Maybe.withDefault typeColor custom

                    colorVars_ =
                        if opts.variant == Tertiary then
                            [ ( "--n-color", v.colorTertiary )
                            , ( "--n-color-hover", v.colorTertiaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-pressed", v.colorTertiaryPressed )
                            , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorSecondaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorTertiary )
                            ]

                        else
                            [ ( "--n-color", v.colorQuaternary )
                            , ( "--n-color-hover", v.colorQuaternaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-pressed", v.colorQuaternaryPressed )
                            , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorQuaternaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorQuaternary )
                            ]
                in
                colorVars_
                    ++ [ ( "--n-ripple-color", "#0000" )
                       , ( "--n-text-color", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-hover", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-focus", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", merged )
                       ]

            else
                [ ( "--n-color", Maybe.withDefault cs.color custom )
                , ( "--n-color-hover"
                  , Maybe.withDefault cs.colorHover (Maybe.map Color.createHoverColor custom)
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-pressed"
                  , Maybe.withDefault cs.colorPressed (Maybe.map Color.createPressedColor custom)
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-focus"
                  , Maybe.withDefault cs.colorFocus (Maybe.map Color.createHoverColor custom)
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-disabled", Maybe.withDefault cs.colorDisabled custom )
                , ( "--n-ripple-color", Maybe.withDefault cs.rippleColor custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColor
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorHoverPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColorHover
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorPressedPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColorPressed
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorFocusPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColorFocus
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorDisabledPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColorDisabled
                            )
                  )
                ]

        borderVars =
            if opts.variant == Text then
                [ ( "--n-border", "none" )
                , ( "--n-border-hover", "none" )
                , ( "--n-border-pressed", "none" )
                , ( "--n-border-focus", "none" )
                , ( "--n-border-disabled", "none" )
                ]

            else
                [ ( "--n-border", cs.border )
                , ( "--n-border-hover", cs.borderHover )
                , ( "--n-border-pressed", cs.borderPressed )
                , ( "--n-border-focus", cs.borderFocus )
                , ( "--n-border-disabled", cs.borderDisabled )
                ]

        sizeVars =
            [ ( "--n-width"
              , if opts.circle && not isText then
                    height

                else
                    "initial"
              )
            , ( "--n-height"
              , if isText then
                    "initial"

                else
                    height
              )
            , ( "--n-font-size", fontSize )
            , ( "--n-padding"
              , if opts.circle then
                    "initial"

                else if isText then
                    "initial"

                else if opts.round then
                    paddingRound

                else
                    padding
              )
            , ( "--n-icon-size", iconSize )
            , ( "--n-icon-margin", iconMargin )
            , ( "--n-border-radius"
              , if isText then
                    "initial"

                else if opts.circle || opts.round then
                    height

                else
                    borderRadius
              )
            ]
    in
    [ ( "--n-bezier", common.cubicBezierEaseInOut )
    , ( "--n-bezier-ease-out", common.cubicBezierEaseOut )
    , ( "--n-ripple-duration", v.rippleDuration )
    , ( "--n-opacity-disabled", v.opacityDisabled )
    , ( "--n-wave-opacity", v.waveOpacity )
    ]
        ++ fontVars
        ++ colorVars
        ++ borderVars
        ++ sizeVars


customColorVars : Maybe String -> List ( String, String )
customColorVars maybeColor =
    case maybeColor of
        Nothing ->
            []

        Just color ->
            let
                hover =
                    Color.createHoverColor color
            in
            [ ( "--n-border-color", color )
            , ( "--n-border-color-hover", hover )
            , ( "--n-border-color-pressed", Color.createPressedColor color )
            , ( "--n-border-color-focus", hover )
            , ( "--n-border-color-disabled", color )
            ]


{-| Naive UI's `createKey('foo', type)` — the `default` type uses the bare name.
-}
type alias ColorSet =
    { color : String
    , colorHover : String
    , colorPressed : String
    , colorFocus : String
    , colorDisabled : String
    , rippleColor : String
    , textColor : String
    , textColorHover : String
    , textColorPressed : String
    , textColorFocus : String
    , textColorDisabled : String
    , textColorText : String
    , textColorTextHover : String
    , textColorTextPressed : String
    , textColorTextDisabled : String
    , textColorGhost : String
    , textColorGhostHover : String
    , textColorGhostPressed : String
    , textColorGhostDisabled : String
    , border : String
    , borderHover : String
    , borderPressed : String
    , borderFocus : String
    , borderDisabled : String
    }


colorSet : Kind -> ButtonTheme.Vars -> ColorSet
colorSet kind v =
    case kind of
        Default ->
            { color = v.color
            , colorHover = v.colorHover
            , colorPressed = v.colorPressed
            , colorFocus = v.colorFocus
            , colorDisabled = v.colorDisabled
            , rippleColor = v.rippleColor
            , textColor = v.textColor
            , textColorHover = v.textColorHover
            , textColorPressed = v.textColorPressed
            , textColorFocus = v.textColorFocus
            , textColorDisabled = v.textColorDisabled
            , textColorText = v.textColorText
            , textColorTextHover = v.textColorTextHover
            , textColorTextPressed = v.textColorTextPressed
            , textColorTextDisabled = v.textColorTextDisabled
            , textColorGhost = v.textColorGhost
            , textColorGhostHover = v.textColorGhostHover
            , textColorGhostPressed = v.textColorGhostPressed
            , textColorGhostDisabled = v.textColorGhostDisabled
            , border = v.border
            , borderHover = v.borderHover
            , borderPressed = v.borderPressed
            , borderFocus = v.borderFocus
            , borderDisabled = v.borderDisabled
            }

        Primary ->
            { color = v.colorPrimary
            , colorHover = v.colorHoverPrimary
            , colorPressed = v.colorPressedPrimary
            , colorFocus = v.colorFocusPrimary
            , colorDisabled = v.colorDisabledPrimary
            , rippleColor = v.rippleColorPrimary
            , textColor = v.textColorPrimary
            , textColorHover = v.textColorHoverPrimary
            , textColorPressed = v.textColorPressedPrimary
            , textColorFocus = v.textColorFocusPrimary
            , textColorDisabled = v.textColorDisabledPrimary
            , textColorText = v.textColorTextPrimary
            , textColorTextHover = v.textColorTextHoverPrimary
            , textColorTextPressed = v.textColorTextPressedPrimary
            , textColorTextDisabled = v.textColorTextDisabledPrimary
            , textColorGhost = v.textColorGhostPrimary
            , textColorGhostHover = v.textColorGhostHoverPrimary
            , textColorGhostPressed = v.textColorGhostPressedPrimary
            , textColorGhostDisabled = v.textColorGhostDisabledPrimary
            , border = v.borderPrimary
