module NUI.Button exposing
    ( IconPlacement(..)
    , Options
    , Variant(..)
    , defaults
    , view
    )

{-| Naive UI's `Button`, rebuilt on elm-ui.

    NUI.Button.view theme NUI.Button.defaults
        [ Element.text "Default" ]

    NUI.Button.view theme
        { NUI.Button.defaults | kind = NUI.Button.Primary }
        [ Element.text "Primary" ]

The visual result is Naive UI's own: the element carries the `.n-button` BEM classes
and Naive UI's `--n-*` custom properties, and `NUI.Css` ships Naive UI's exact CSS.

-}

import Element exposing (Element)
import Element.Events as Events
import Html.Attributes as HA
import NUI.Internal as I
import NUI.Theme exposing (Theme)
import NUI.Theme.Button as ButtonTheme
import NUI.Theme.Color as Color
import NUI.Types as T exposing (Kind(..), Size(..))


type Variant
    = Filled
    | Secondary
    | Tertiary
    | Quaternary
    | Text


type IconPlacement
    = IconLeft
    | IconRight


type alias Options msg =
    { kind : Kind
    , size : Size
    , variant : Variant
    , ghost : Bool
    , dashed : Bool
    , round : Bool
    , circle : Bool
    , block : Bool
    , disabled : Bool
    , loading : Bool
    , strong : Bool
    , bordered : Bool
    , color : Maybe String
    , textColor : Maybe String
    , icon : Maybe (Element msg)
    , iconPlacement : IconPlacement
    , onPress : Maybe msg
    }


defaults : Options msg
defaults =
    { kind = Default
    , size = Medium
    , variant = Filled
    , ghost = False
    , dashed = False
    , round = False
    , circle = False
    , block = False
    , disabled = False
    , loading = False
    , strong = False
    , bordered = True
    , color = Nothing
    , textColor = Nothing
    , icon = Nothing
    , iconPlacement = IconLeft
    , onPress = Nothing
    }


view : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
view theme opts children =
    let
        v =
            ButtonTheme.vars theme

        isText =
            opts.variant == Text

        showBorder =
            not (List.member opts.variant [ Quaternary, Tertiary, Secondary, Text ])
                && (opts.color == Nothing || opts.ghost || opts.dashed)
                && opts.bordered

        content =
            Element.el [ I.classes [ "n-button__content" ] ] (Element.column [] children)

        iconEl =
            case opts.icon of
                Just ic ->
                    Just (Element.el [ I.classes [ "n-button__icon" ] ] ic)

                Nothing ->
                    Nothing

        body =
            case opts.iconPlacement of
                IconRight ->
                    content :: List.filterMap identity [ iconEl ]

                IconLeft ->
                    List.filterMap identity [ iconEl ] ++ [ content ]

        borderEls =
            if showBorder then
                [ Element.el
                    [ I.classes [ "n-button__border" ]
                    , I.cssVars (customColorVars opts.color)
                    ]
                    Element.none
                , Element.el
                    [ I.classes [ "n-button__state-border" ]
                    , I.cssVars (customColorVars opts.color)
                    ]
                    Element.none
                ]

            else
                []

        classes =
            List.concat
                [ [ "n-button"
                  , "n-button--" ++ T.kindClass opts.kind ++ "-type"
                  , "n-button--" ++ T.sizeClass opts.size ++ "-type"
                  ]
                , I.classIf opts.disabled "n-button--disabled"
                , I.classIf opts.block "n-button--block"
                , I.classIf (opts.dashed && not isText) "n-button--dashed"
                , I.classIf (opts.color /= Nothing) "n-button--color"
                , I.classIf (opts.variant == Secondary) "n-button--secondary"
                , I.classIf opts.loading "n-button--loading"
                , I.classIf opts.ghost "n-button--ghost"
                ]

        interactive =
            if opts.disabled || opts.loading then
                [ Element.htmlAttribute (HA.attribute "aria-disabled" "true") ]

            else
                [ Element.htmlAttribute (HA.attribute "role" "button")
                , Element.htmlAttribute (HA.tabindex 0)
                ]
                    ++ (case opts.onPress of
                            Just msg ->
                                [ Events.onClick msg ]

                            Nothing ->
                                []
                       )
    in
    Element.row
        (I.classes classes
            :: I.cssVars (cssVars theme opts v)
            :: interactive
        )
        (body ++ borderEls)


cssVars : Theme -> Options msg -> ButtonTheme.Vars -> List ( String, String )
cssVars theme opts v =
    let
        common =
            theme.common

        isText =
            opts.variant == Text

        cs =
            colorSet opts.kind v

        height =
            heightOf opts.size v

        fontSize =
            fontSizeOf opts.size v

        padding =
            paddingOf opts.size v

        paddingRound =
            paddingRoundOf opts.size v

        iconSize =
            iconSizeOf opts.size v

        borderRadius =
            borderRadiusOf opts.size v

        iconMargin =
            iconMarginOf opts.size v

        custom =
            opts.color

        customText =
            opts.textColor

        fontVars =
            [ ( "--n-font-weight"
              , if opts.strong then
                    v.fontWeightStrong

                else
                    v.fontWeight
              )
            ]

        colorVars =
            if opts.variant == Text then
                let
                    base =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorText custom

                    hover =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextHover custom
                in
                [ ( "--n-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-text-color", base )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", hover )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextPressed custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", hover )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorTextDisabled custom )
                ]

            else if opts.ghost || opts.dashed then
                let
                    base =
                        Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhost custom
                in
                [ ( "--n-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-ripple-color", Maybe.withDefault cs.rippleColor custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color", base )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostHover custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostPressed custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostHover custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", Maybe.withDefault cs.textColorGhostDisabled custom )
                ]

            else if opts.variant == Secondary then
                let
                    isColored =
                        opts.kind /= Default

                    typeText =
                        case opts.kind of
                            Default ->
                                v.textColor

                            _ ->
                                cs.color

                    merged =
                        Maybe.withDefault typeText custom

                    colored alpha =
                        Color.changeColor merged alpha
                in
                [ ( "--n-color"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondary |> Maybe.withDefault 0.16)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondary
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-hover"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondaryHover |> Maybe.withDefault 0.22)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondaryHover
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-pressed"
                  , if isColored then
                        colored (String.toFloat v.colorOpacitySecondaryPressed |> Maybe.withDefault 0.28)

                    else
                        v.colorSecondaryPressed
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorSecondaryHover )
                , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorSecondary )
                , ( "--n-ripple-color", "#0000" )
                , ( "--n-text-color", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus", merged )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", merged )
                ]

            else if opts.variant == Tertiary || opts.variant == Quaternary then
                let
                    typeColor =
                        case opts.kind of
                            Default ->
                                v.textColor

                            _ ->
                                cs.color

                    merged =
                        Maybe.withDefault typeColor custom

                    colorVars_ =
                        if opts.variant == Tertiary then
                            [ ( "--n-color", v.colorTertiary )
                            , ( "--n-color-hover", v.colorTertiaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-pressed", v.colorTertiaryPressed )
                            , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorSecondaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorTertiary )
                            ]

                        else
                            [ ( "--n-color", v.colorQuaternary )
                            , ( "--n-color-hover", v.colorQuaternaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-pressed", v.colorQuaternaryPressed )
                            , ( "--n-color-focus", v.colorQuaternaryHover )
                            , ( "--n-color-disabled", v.colorQuaternary )
                            ]
                in
                colorVars_
                    ++ [ ( "--n-ripple-color", "#0000" )
                       , ( "--n-text-color", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-hover", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-pressed", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-focus", merged )
                       , ( "--n-text-color-disabled", merged )
                       ]

            else
                [ ( "--n-color", Maybe.withDefault cs.color custom )
                , ( "--n-color-hover"
                  , Maybe.withDefault cs.colorHover (Maybe.map Color.createHoverColor custom)
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-pressed"
                  , Maybe.withDefault cs.colorPressed (Maybe.map Color.createPressedColor custom)
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-focus"
                  , Maybe.withDefault cs.colorFocus (Maybe.map Color.createHoverColor custom)
                  )
                , ( "--n-color-disabled", Maybe.withDefault cs.colorDisabled custom )
                , ( "--n-ripple-color", Maybe.withDefault cs.rippleColor custom )
                , ( "--n-text-color"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColor
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-hover"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorHoverPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColorHover
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-pressed"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorPressedPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColorPressed
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-focus"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorFocusPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColorFocus
                            )
                  )
                , ( "--n-text-color-disabled"
                  , customText
                        |> Maybe.withDefault
                            (if custom /= Nothing then
                                v.textColorDisabledPrimary

                             else
                                cs.textColorDisabled
                            )
                  )
                ]

        borderVars =
            if opts.variant == Text then
                [ ( "--n-border", "none" )
                , ( "--n-border-hover", "none" )
                , ( "--n-border-pressed", "none" )
                , ( "--n-border-focus", "none" )
                , ( "--n-border-disabled", "none" )
                ]

            else
                [ ( "--n-border", cs.border )
                , ( "--n-border-hover", cs.borderHover )
                , ( "--n-border-pressed", cs.borderPressed )
                , ( "--n-border-focus", cs.borderFocus )
                , ( "--n-border-disabled", cs.borderDisabled )
                ]

        sizeVars =
            [ ( "--n-width"
              , if opts.circle && not isText then
                    height

                else
                    "initial"
              )
            , ( "--n-height"
              , if isText then
                    "initial"

                else
                    height
              )
            , ( "--n-font-size", fontSize )
            , ( "--n-padding"
              , if opts.circle then
                    "initial"

                else if isText then
                    "initial"

                else if opts.round then
                    paddingRound

                else
                    padding
              )
            , ( "--n-icon-size", iconSize )
            , ( "--n-icon-margin", iconMargin )
            , ( "--n-border-radius"
              , if isText then
                    "initial"

                else if opts.circle || opts.round then
                    height

                else
                    borderRadius
              )
            ]
    in
    [ ( "--n-bezier", common.cubicBezierEaseInOut )
    , ( "--n-bezier-ease-out", common.cubicBezierEaseOut )
    , ( "--n-ripple-duration", v.rippleDuration )
    , ( "--n-opacity-disabled", v.opacityDisabled )
    , ( "--n-wave-opacity", v.waveOpacity )
    ]
        ++ fontVars
        ++ colorVars
        ++ borderVars
        ++ sizeVars

Every element carries the same BEM classes and the same `--n-*` custom properties
Naive UI emits, so with `NUI.Css` in scope it renders using Naive UI's own CSS.

    NUI.Typography.h1 theme NUI.Typography.defaults
        [ Element.text "Wonderful" ]

    NUI.Typography.text theme

import Element.Events as Events
import Html.Attributes as HA
import NUI.Internal as I
import NUI.Theme exposing (Theme)
import NUI.Theme.Typography as ThemeTypography
import NUI.Types as T exposing (Kind(..))

{-| Text alignment for the `align` option (`text-align`).
-}
type FontAlign
    = AlignLeft
    | AlignCenter
    | AlignRight
    | AlignJustify

    { kind : Kind
    , depth : Maybe Int
    , strong : Bool
    , italic : Bool
    , underline : Bool
    , delete : Bool
    , code : Bool
    , prefixBar : Bool
    , alignText : Bool
    , size : Maybe Int
    , align : Maybe FontAlign
    , fontWeight : Maybe String
    , href : Maybe String
    , onPress : Maybe msg
    }


defaults : Options msg
defaults =
    { kind = T.Default
    , depth = Nothing
    , strong = False
    , italic = False
    , underline = False
    , delete = False
    , code = False
    , prefixBar = False
    , alignText = False
    , size = Nothing
    , align = Nothing
    , fontWeight = Nothing
    , href = Nothing
    , onPress = Nothing
    }

{-| Naive UI's `Text` — `.n-text` on a flow element.

`kind` maps its `type` prop, `depth` (1-3) only applies to the `default` kind,
`strong` / `italic` / `underline` / `code` add the matching `n-text--*` class, and
`delete` strikes the text through (Naive UI renders a `<del>`; we cannot, so the
`text-decoration` is applied inline).

-}
text : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
text theme opts children =
    let
        v =
            ThemeTypography.vars theme

        classes =
            List.concat
                [ [ "n-text" ]
                , I.classIf opts.code "n-text--code"
                , I.classIf opts.delete "n-text--delete"
                , I.classIf opts.strong "n-text--strong"
                , I.classIf opts.italic "n-text--italic"
                , I.classIf opts.underline "n-text--underline"
                ]
    in
    Element.paragraph
        [ I.classes classes
        , I.cssVars (textCssVars theme opts v ++ deleteStyles opts ++ convenienceStyles opts)
        ]
        children


textCssVars : Theme -> Options msg -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> List ( String, String )
textCssVars theme opts v =
    [ ( "--n-bezier", theme.common.cubicBezierEaseInOut )
    , ( "--n-text-color", textColorOf opts.kind opts.depth v )
    , ( "--n-font-weight-strong", theme.common.fontWeightStrong )
    , ( "--n-font-famliy-mono", theme.common.fontFamilyMono )
    , ( "--n-code-border-radius", v.codeBorderRadius )
    , ( "--n-code-text-color", v.codeTextColor )
    , ( "--n-code-color", v.codeColor )
    , ( "--n-code-border", v.codeBorder )
    ]


{-| `type === 'default' ? textColor${depth}Depth : createKey('textColor', type)`.
-}
textColorOf : Kind -> Maybe Int -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> String
textColorOf kind depth v =
    case kind of
        T.Default ->
            case depth of
                Nothing ->
                    v.textColor

                Just d ->
                    if d <= 1 then
                        v.textColor1Depth

                    else if d == 2 then
                        v.textColor2Depth

                    else
                        v.textColor3Depth

        T.Primary ->
            v.textColorPrimary

        T.Info ->
            v.textColorInfo

        T.Success ->
            v.textColorSuccess

        T.Warning ->
            v.textColorWarning

        T.Error ->
            v.textColorError

type HeaderLevel

    | H2
    | H3
    | H4
    | H5
    | H6

colour, `prefixBar` adds `.n-h--prefix-bar`, `alignText` adds `.n-h--align-text`.
-}

    header H1


h2 : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
h2 =
    header H2


h3 : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
h3 =
    header H3


h4 : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
h4 =
    header H4


h5 : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg

    header H5


h6 : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg

    header H6

    let
        v =
            ThemeTypography.vars theme

            List.concat
                [ [ "n-h", "n-h" ++ levelSuffix level ]
                , I.classIf opts.prefixBar "n-h--prefix-bar"
                , I.classIf opts.alignText "n-h--align-text"
                ]
    in
    Element.paragraph
        [ I.classes classes
        , I.cssVars (headerCssVars theme opts v level ++ blockDisplay ++ convenienceStyles opts)
        ]

headerCssVars : Theme -> Options msg -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> HeaderLevel -> List ( String, String )

    [ ( "--n-bezier", theme.common.cubicBezierEaseInOut )
    , ( "--n-font-size", headerFontSize level v )
    , ( "--n-margin", headerMargin level v )
    , ( "--n-bar-color", headerBarColorOf opts.kind v )
    , ( "--n-bar-width", headerBarWidth level v )
    , ( "--n-font-weight", v.headerFontWeight )
    , ( "--n-text-color", v.headerTextColor )
    , ( "--n-prefix-width", headerPrefixWidth level v )
    ]


{-| `createKey('headerBarColor', type)` — `default` uses the bare name.
-}
headerBarColorOf : Kind -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> String
headerBarColorOf kind v =
    case kind of
        T.Default ->
            v.headerBarColor

        T.Primary ->
            v.headerBarColorPrimary

        T.Info ->
            v.headerBarColorInfo

        T.Success ->
            v.headerBarColorSuccess

        T.Warning ->
            v.headerBarColorWarning

        T.Error ->
            v.headerBarColorError


levelSuffix : HeaderLevel -> String
levelSuffix level =
    case level of
        H1 ->
            "1"

        H2 ->
            "2"

        H3 ->
            "3"

        H4 ->
            "4"

        H5 ->
            "5"

        H6 ->
            "6"


headerFontSize : HeaderLevel -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> String
headerFontSize level v =
    case level of
        H1 ->
            v.headerFontSize1

        H2 ->
            v.headerFontSize2

        H3 ->
            v.headerFontSize3

        H4 ->
            v.headerFontSize4

        H5 ->
            v.headerFontSize5

        H6 ->

headerMargin : HeaderLevel -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> String

        H1 ->

        H2 ->

            v.headerMargin3

        H4 ->
            v.headerMargin4

        H5 ->
            v.headerMargin5

        H6 ->

        H1 ->

        H2 ->
            v.headerPrefixWidth2

        H3 ->
            v.headerPrefixWidth3

        H4 ->
            v.headerPrefixWidth4

        H5 ->
            v.headerPrefixWidth5

        H6 ->
            v.headerPrefixWidth6


headerBarWidth : HeaderLevel -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> String
headerBarWidth level v =
    case level of
        H1 ->
            v.headerBarWidth1

        H2 ->
            v.headerBarWidth2

        H3 ->
            v.headerBarWidth3

        H4 ->
            v.headerBarWidth4

        H5 ->
            v.headerBarWidth5

        H6 ->
            v.headerBarWidth6

{-| Naive UI's `P` — `.n-p`. `depth` (1-3) selects `pTextColor{depth}Depth`.
-}
p : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
p theme opts children =
    let
        v =
            ThemeTypography.vars theme
    in
    Element.paragraph
        [ I.classes [ "n-p" ]
        , I.cssVars (pCssVars theme opts v ++ blockDisplay ++ convenienceStyles opts)
        ]
        children


pCssVars : Theme -> Options msg -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> List ( String, String )
pCssVars theme opts v =
    [ ( "--n-bezier", theme.common.cubicBezierEaseInOut )
    , ( "--n-font-size", v.pFontSize )
    , ( "--n-line-height", v.pLineHeight )
    , ( "--n-margin", v.pMargin )
    , ( "--n-text-color", pTextColorOf opts.depth v )
    ]


{-| `depth === undefined ? pTextColor : pTextColor${depth || '1'}Depth`.
-}
pTextColorOf : Maybe Int -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> String
pTextColorOf depth v =
    case depth of
        Nothing ->
            v.pTextColor

        Just d ->
            if d <= 1 then
                v.pTextColor1Depth

            else if d == 2 then
                v.pTextColor2Depth

            else
                v.pTextColor3Depth



-- Anchor


{-| Naive UI's `A` — `.n-a`. With `href` a real anchor is rendered (via
`Element.link`); otherwise a styled element that still picks up `.n-a`'s
`cursor: pointer` look. `onPress` attaches a click handler and link semantics.
-}
a : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
a theme opts children =
    let
        v =
            ThemeTypography.vars theme

        attrs =
            [ I.classes [ "n-a" ]
            , I.cssVars (aCssVars theme v ++ convenienceStyles opts)
            ]
                ++ linkAttrs opts

        body =
            Element.paragraph [] children
    in
    case opts.href of
        Just url ->
            Element.link attrs { url = url, label = body }

        Nothing ->
            Element.el attrs body


aCssVars : Theme -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> List ( String, String )
aCssVars theme v =
    [ ( "--n-text-color", v.aTextColor )
    , ( "--n-bezier", theme.common.cubicBezierEaseInOut )
    ]


linkAttrs : Options msg -> List (Element.Attribute msg)
linkAttrs opts =
    case opts.onPress of
        Just msg ->
            [ Events.onClick msg
            , Element.htmlAttribute (HA.attribute "role" "link")
            , Element.htmlAttribute (HA.tabindex 0)
            ]

        Nothing ->
            []

{-| Naive UI's `Blockquote` — `.n-blockquote` (+ `--align-text`).
-}
blockquote : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg

    let
        v =
            ThemeTypography.vars theme

        classes =
            List.concat
                [ [ "n-blockquote" ]
                , I.classIf opts.alignText "n-blockquote--align-text"
                ]
    in
    Element.paragraph
        [ I.classes classes
        , I.cssVars (blockquoteCssVars theme v ++ blockDisplay ++ convenienceStyles opts)
        ]
        children


blockquoteCssVars : Theme -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> List ( String, String )
blockquoteCssVars theme v =
    [ ( "--n-bezier", theme.common.cubicBezierEaseInOut )
    , ( "--n-font-size", v.blockquoteFontSize )
    , ( "--n-line-height", v.blockquoteLineHeight )
    , ( "--n-prefix-color", v.blockquotePrefixColor )
    , ( "--n-text-color", v.blockquoteTextColor )
    ]



-- Hr


{-| Naive UI's `Hr` — `.n-hr`, a plain themed separator.
-}
hr : Theme -> Element msg
hr theme =
    let
        v =
            ThemeTypography.vars theme
    in
    Element.el
        [ I.classes [ "n-hr" ]
        , I.cssVars (hrCssVars theme v ++ blockDisplay)
        ]
        Element.none


hrCssVars : Theme -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> List ( String, String )
hrCssVars theme v =
    [ ( "--n-bezier", theme.common.cubicBezierEaseInOut )
    , ( "--n-color", v.hrColor )
    ]



-- Lists


{-| Naive UI's `Ul` — `.n-ul` (+ `--align-text`).
-}
ul : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
ul =
    list False


{-| Naive UI's `Ol` — `.n-ol` (+ `--align-text`).
-}
ol : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
ol =
    list True


list : Bool -> Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
list ordered theme opts children =
    let
        v =
            ThemeTypography.vars theme

        base =
            if ordered then
                "n-ol"

            else
                "n-ul"

        classes =
            List.concat
                [ [ base ]
                , I.classIf opts.alignText (base ++ "--align-text")
                ]
    in
    Element.paragraph
        [ I.classes classes
        , I.cssVars (listCssVars theme v ++ uaListStyles ordered ++ convenienceStyles opts)
        ]
        children


listCssVars : Theme -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> List ( String, String )
listCssVars theme v =
    [ ( "--n-bezier", theme.common.cubicBezierEaseInOut )
    , ( "--n-font-size", v.liFontSize )
    , ( "--n-line-height", v.liLineHeight )
    , ( "--n-text-color", v.liTextColor )
    , ( "--n-li-margin", v.liMargin )
    , ( "--n-ol-padding", v.olPadding )
    , ( "--n-ul-padding", v.ulPadding )
    ]


{-| What a native `<ul>` / `<ol>` contributes and Naive UI relies on:
block display, inherited markers, and default block margins. Naive UI styles the
padding (via `--n-*-padding`) itself, markers and margins come from the browser.
-}
uaListStyles : Bool -> List ( String, String )
uaListStyles ordered =
    [ ( "display", "block" )
    , ( "list-style-type"
      , if ordered then
            "decimal"

        else
            "disc"
      )
    , ( "margin-top", "1em" )
    , ( "margin-bottom", "1em" )
    ]


{-| Naive UI's `Li` — a bare `<li>` (no classes, no vars of its own; the styles
come from the `.n-ul li` / `.n-ol li` rules and the vars defined by the
surrounding list). We emit the `n-li` class for parity and restate those
tag-selector rules inline, since our element is not an `<li>` tag.
-}
li : List (Element msg) -> Element msg
li children =
    Element.paragraph
        [ I.classes [ "n-li" ]
        , I.cssVars liStyles
        ]
        children


{-| The `.n-ul li` rule: `transition / line-height / margin / color`, plus the
`display: list-item` and marker a native `<li>` gets from the browser. The
`var(--n-*)` references resolve against the surrounding list's inline vars.
-}
liStyles : List ( String, String )
liStyles =
    [ ( "display", "list-item" )
    , ( "transition", "color .3s var(--n-bezier)" )
    , ( "line-height", "var(--n-line-height)" )
    , ( "margin", "var(--n-li-margin)" )
    , ( "margin-bottom", "0" )
    , ( "color", "var(--n-text-color)" )
    ]



-- Shared style helpers


{-| Keep block-level typography block-level even when nested inside an elm-ui
paragraph (whose `.s.p .s.p { display: inline }` rule would otherwise inline it —
native block tags can never end up inline inside text flow).
-}
blockDisplay : List ( String, String )
blockDisplay =
    [ ( "display", "block" )
    ]


{-| Naive UI's `<del>`: `text-decoration: line-through`. Skipped when
`n-text--underline` is set, mirroring the cascade where the author underline rule
replaces the `<del>`'s user-agent line-through.
-}
deleteStyles : Options msg -> List ( String, String )
deleteStyles opts =
    if opts.delete && not opts.underline then
        [ ( "text-decoration", "line-through" )
        ]

    else
        []


{-| Elm-side conveniences Naive UI does not offer as props: `size` (px),
`fontWeight` (any CSS value) and `align` (`text-align`). Emitted inline so they
win over both elm-ui helper classes and the scoped Naive UI rules.
-}
convenienceStyles : Options msg -> List ( String, String )
convenienceStyles opts =
    List.concat
        [ maybeStyle "font-size" (Maybe.map (\px -> String.fromInt px ++ "px") opts.size)
        , maybeStyle "font-weight" opts.fontWeight
        , maybeStyle "text-align" (Maybe.map alignCss opts.align)
        ]


maybeStyle : String -> Maybe String -> List ( String, String )
maybeStyle prop value =
    case value of
        Just v ->
            [ ( prop, v ) ]

        Nothing ->
            []


alignCss : FontAlign -> String
alignCss align =
    case align of
        AlignLeft ->
            "left"

        AlignCenter ->
            "center"

        AlignRight ->
            "right"

        AlignJustify ->
            "justify"

    { kind = T.Default
    , depth = Nothing
    , strong = False
    , italic = False
    , underline = False
    , delete = False
    , code = False
    , prefixBar = False
    , alignText = False
    , size = Nothing
    , align = Nothing
    , fontWeight = Nothing
    , href = Nothing
    , onPress = Nothing
    }



-- Text


{-| Naive UI's `Text` — `.n-text` on a flow element.

`kind` maps its `type` prop, `depth` (1-3) only applies to the `default` kind,
`strong` / `italic` / `underline` / `code` add the matching `n-text--*` class, and
`delete` strikes the text through (Naive UI renders a `<del>`; we cannot, so the
`text-decoration` is applied inline).

-}
text : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
text theme opts children =
    let
        v =
            ThemeTypography.vars theme

        classes =
            List.concat
                [ [ "n-text" ]
                , I.classIf opts.code "n-text--code"
                , I.classIf opts.delete "n-text--delete"
                , I.classIf opts.strong "n-text--strong"
                , I.classIf opts.italic "n-text--italic"
                , I.classIf opts.underline "n-text--underline"
                ]
    in
    Element.paragraph
        [ I.classes classes
        , I.cssVars (textCssVars theme opts v ++ deleteStyles opts ++ convenienceStyles opts)
        ]
        children


textCssVars : Theme -> Options msg -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> List ( String, String )
textCssVars theme opts v =
    [ ( "--n-bezier", theme.common.cubicBezierEaseInOut )
    , ( "--n-text-color", textColorOf opts.kind opts.depth v )
    , ( "--n-font-weight-strong", theme.common.fontWeightStrong )
    , ( "--n-font-famliy-mono", theme.common.fontFamilyMono )
    , ( "--n-code-border-radius", v.codeBorderRadius )
    , ( "--n-code-text-color", v.codeTextColor )
    , ( "--n-code-color", v.codeColor )
    , ( "--n-code-border", v.codeBorder )
    ]


{-| `type === 'default' ? textColor${depth}Depth : createKey('textColor', type)`.
-}
textColorOf : Kind -> Maybe Int -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> String
textColorOf kind depth v =
    case kind of
        T.Default ->
            case depth of
                Nothing ->
                    v.textColor

                Just d ->
                    if d <= 1 then
                        v.textColor1Depth

                    else if d == 2 then
                        v.textColor2Depth

                    else
                        v.textColor3Depth

        T.Primary ->
            v.textColorPrimary

        T.Info ->
            v.textColorInfo

        T.Success ->
            v.textColorSuccess

        T.Warning ->
            v.textColorWarning

        T.Error ->
            v.textColorError



-- Headers


type HeaderLevel
    = H1
    | H2
    | H3
    | H4
    | H5
    | H6


{-| Naive UI's `H1`-`H6` — `.n-h .n-h{level}`. `kind` selects the prefix-bar
colour, `prefixBar` adds `.n-h--prefix-bar`, `alignText` adds `.n-h--align-text`.
-}
h1 : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
h1 =
    header H1


h2 : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
h2 =
    header H2


h3 : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
h3 =
    header H3


h4 : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
h4 =
    header H4


h5 : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
h5 =
    header H5


h6 : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
h6 =
    header H6


header : HeaderLevel -> Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
header level theme opts children =
    let
        v =
            ThemeTypography.vars theme

        classes =
            List.concat
                [ [ "n-h", "n-h" ++ levelSuffix level ]
                , I.classIf opts.prefixBar "n-h--prefix-bar"
                , I.classIf opts.alignText "n-h--align-text"
                ]
    in
    Element.paragraph
        [ I.classes classes
        , I.cssVars (headerCssVars theme opts v level ++ blockDisplay ++ convenienceStyles opts)
        ]
        children


headerCssVars : Theme -> Options msg -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> HeaderLevel -> List ( String, String )
headerCssVars theme opts v level =
    [ ( "--n-bezier", theme.common.cubicBezierEaseInOut )
    , ( "--n-font-size", headerFontSize level v )
    , ( "--n-margin", headerMargin level v )
    , ( "--n-bar-color", headerBarColorOf opts.kind v )
    , ( "--n-bar-width", headerBarWidth level v )
    , ( "--n-font-weight", v.headerFontWeight )
    , ( "--n-text-color", v.headerTextColor )
    , ( "--n-prefix-width", headerPrefixWidth level v )
    ]


{-| `createKey('headerBarColor', type)` — `default` uses the bare name.
-}
headerBarColorOf : Kind -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> String
headerBarColorOf kind v =
    case kind of
        T.Default ->
            v.headerBarColor

        T.Primary ->
            v.headerBarColorPrimary

        T.Info ->
            v.headerBarColorInfo

        T.Success ->
            v.headerBarColorSuccess

        T.Warning ->
            v.headerBarColorWarning

        T.Error ->
            v.headerBarColorError


levelSuffix : HeaderLevel -> String
levelSuffix level =
    case level of
        H1 ->
            "1"

        H2 ->
            "2"

        H3 ->
            "3"

        H4 ->
            "4"

        H5 ->
            "5"

        H6 ->
            "6"


headerFontSize : HeaderLevel -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> String
headerFontSize level v =
    case level of
        H1 ->
            v.headerFontSize1

        H2 ->
            v.headerFontSize2

        H3 ->
            v.headerFontSize3

        H4 ->
            v.headerFontSize4

        H5 ->
            v.headerFontSize5

        H6 ->
            v.headerFontSize6


headerMargin : HeaderLevel -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> String
headerMargin level v =
    case level of
        H1 ->
            v.headerMargin1

        H2 ->
            v.headerMargin2

        H3 ->
            v.headerMargin3

        H4 ->
            v.headerMargin4

        H5 ->
            v.headerMargin5

        H6 ->
            v.headerMargin6


headerPrefixWidth : HeaderLevel -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> String
headerPrefixWidth level v =
    case level of
        H1 ->
            v.headerPrefixWidth1

        H2 ->
            v.headerPrefixWidth2

        H3 ->
            v.headerPrefixWidth3

        H4 ->
            v.headerPrefixWidth4

        H5 ->
            v.headerPrefixWidth5

        H6 ->
            v.headerPrefixWidth6


headerBarWidth : HeaderLevel -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> String
headerBarWidth level v =
    case level of
        H1 ->
            v.headerBarWidth1

        H2 ->
            v.headerBarWidth2

        H3 ->
            v.headerBarWidth3

        H4 ->
            v.headerBarWidth4

        H5 ->
            v.headerBarWidth5

        H6 ->
            v.headerBarWidth6



-- Paragraph


{-| Naive UI's `P` — `.n-p`. `depth` (1-3) selects `pTextColor{depth}Depth`.
-}
p : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
p theme opts children =
    let
        v =
            ThemeTypography.vars theme
    in
    Element.paragraph
        [ I.classes [ "n-p" ]
        , I.cssVars (pCssVars theme opts v ++ blockDisplay ++ convenienceStyles opts)
        ]
        children


pCssVars : Theme -> Options msg -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> List ( String, String )
pCssVars theme opts v =
    [ ( "--n-bezier", theme.common.cubicBezierEaseInOut )
    , ( "--n-font-size", v.pFontSize )
    , ( "--n-line-height", v.pLineHeight )
    , ( "--n-margin", v.pMargin )
    , ( "--n-text-color", pTextColorOf opts.depth v )
    ]


{-| `depth === undefined ? pTextColor : pTextColor${depth || '1'}Depth`.
-}
pTextColorOf : Maybe Int -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> String
pTextColorOf depth v =
    case depth of
        Nothing ->
            v.pTextColor

        Just d ->
            if d <= 1 then
                v.pTextColor1Depth

            else if d == 2 then
                v.pTextColor2Depth

            else
                v.pTextColor3Depth



-- Anchor


{-| Naive UI's `A` — `.n-a`. With `href` a real anchor is rendered (via
`Element.link`); otherwise a styled element that still picks up `.n-a`'s
`cursor: pointer` look. `onPress` attaches a click handler and link semantics.
-}
a : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
a theme opts children =
    let
        v =
            ThemeTypography.vars theme

        attrs =
            [ I.classes [ "n-a" ]
            , I.cssVars (aCssVars theme v ++ convenienceStyles opts)
            ]
                ++ linkAttrs opts

        body =
            Element.paragraph [] children
    in
    case opts.href of
        Just url ->
            Element.link attrs { url = url, label = body }

        Nothing ->
            Element.el attrs body


aCssVars : Theme -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> List ( String, String )
aCssVars theme v =
    [ ( "--n-text-color", v.aTextColor )
    , ( "--n-bezier", theme.common.cubicBezierEaseInOut )
    ]


linkAttrs : Options msg -> List (Element.Attribute msg)
linkAttrs opts =
    case opts.onPress of
        Just msg ->
            [ Events.onClick msg
            , Element.htmlAttribute (HA.attribute "role" "link")
            , Element.htmlAttribute (HA.tabindex 0)
            ]

        Nothing ->
            []



-- Blockquote


{-| Naive UI's `Blockquote` — `.n-blockquote` (+ `--align-text`).
-}
blockquote : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
blockquote theme opts children =
    let
        v =
            ThemeTypography.vars theme

        classes =
            List.concat
                [ [ "n-blockquote" ]
                , I.classIf opts.alignText "n-blockquote--align-text"
                ]
    in
    Element.paragraph
        [ I.classes classes
        , I.cssVars (blockquoteCssVars theme v ++ blockDisplay ++ convenienceStyles opts)
        ]
        children


blockquoteCssVars : Theme -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> List ( String, String )
blockquoteCssVars theme v =
    [ ( "--n-bezier", theme.common.cubicBezierEaseInOut )
    , ( "--n-font-size", v.blockquoteFontSize )
    , ( "--n-line-height", v.blockquoteLineHeight )
    , ( "--n-prefix-color", v.blockquotePrefixColor )
    , ( "--n-text-color", v.blockquoteTextColor )
    ]



-- Hr


{-| Naive UI's `Hr` — `.n-hr`, a plain themed separator.
-}
hr : Theme -> Element msg
hr theme =
    let
        v =
            ThemeTypography.vars theme
    in
    Element.el
        [ I.classes [ "n-hr" ]
        , I.cssVars (hrCssVars theme v ++ blockDisplay)
        ]
        Element.none


hrCssVars : Theme -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> List ( String, String )
hrCssVars theme v =
    [ ( "--n-bezier", theme.common.cubicBezierEaseInOut )
    , ( "--n-color", v.hrColor )
    ]



-- Lists


{-| Naive UI's `Ul` — `.n-ul` (+ `--align-text`).
-}
ul : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
ul =
    list False


{-| Naive UI's `Ol` — `.n-ol` (+ `--align-text`).
-}
ol : Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
ol =
    list True


list : Bool -> Theme -> Options msg -> List (Element msg) -> Element msg
list ordered theme opts children =
    let
        v =
            ThemeTypography.vars theme

        base =
            if ordered then
                "n-ol"

            else
                "n-ul"

        classes =
            List.concat
                [ [ base ]
                , I.classIf opts.alignText (base ++ "--align-text")
                ]
    in
    Element.paragraph
        [ I.classes classes
        , I.cssVars (listCssVars theme v ++ uaListStyles ordered ++ convenienceStyles opts)
        ]
        children


listCssVars : Theme -> ThemeTypography.Vars -> List ( String, String )
listCssVars theme v =
    [ ( "--n-bezier", theme.common.cubicBezierEaseInOut )
    , ( "--n-font-size", v.liFontSize )
    , ( "--n-line-height", v.liLineHeight )
    , ( "--n-text-color", v.liTextColor )
    , ( "--n-li-margin", v.liMargin )
    , ( "--n-ol-padding", v.olPadding )
    , ( "--n-ul-padding", v.ulPadding )
    ]


{-| What a native `<ul>` / `<ol>` contributes and Naive UI relies on:
block display, inherited markers, and default block margins. Naive UI styles the
padding (via `--n-*-padding`) itself, markers and margins come from the browser.
-}
uaListStyles : Bool -> List ( String, String )
uaListStyles ordered =
    [ ( "display", "block" )
    , ( "list-style-type"
      , if ordered then
            "decimal"

        else
            "disc"
      )
    , ( "margin-top", "1em" )
    , ( "margin-bottom", "1em" )
    ]


{-| Naive UI's `Li` — a bare `<li>` (no classes, no vars of its own; the styles
come from the `.n-ul li` / `.n-ol li` rules and the vars defined by the
surrounding list). We emit the `n-li` class for parity and restate those
tag-selector rules inline, since our element is not an `<li>` tag.
-}
li : List (Element msg) -> Element msg
li children =
    Element.paragraph
        [ I.classes [ "n-li" ]
        , I.cssVars liStyles
        ]
        children


{-| The `.n-ul li` rule: `transition / line-height / margin / color`, plus the
`display: list-item` and marker a native `<li>` gets from the browser. The
`var(--n-*)` references resolve against the surrounding list's inline vars.
-}
liStyles : List ( String, String )
liStyles =
    [ ( "display", "list-item" )
    , ( "transition", "color .3s var(--n-bezier)" )
    , ( "line-height", "var(--n-line-height)" )
    , ( "margin", "var(--n-li-margin)" )
    , ( "margin-bottom", "0" )
    , ( "color", "var(--n-text-color)" )
    ]



-- Shared style helpers


{-| Keep block-level typography block-level even when nested inside an elm-ui
paragraph (whose `.s.p .s.p { display: inline }` rule would otherwise inline it —
native block tags can never end up inline inside text flow).
-}
blockDisplay : List ( String, String )
blockDisplay =
    [ ( "display", "block" )
    ]


{-| Naive UI's `<del>`: `text-decoration: line-through`. Skipped when
`n-text--underline` is set, mirroring the cascade where the author underline rule
replaces the `<del>`'s user-agent line-through.
-}
deleteStyles : Options msg -> List ( String, String )
deleteStyles opts =
    if opts.delete && not opts.underline then
        [ ( "text-decoration", "line-through" )
        ]

    else
        []


{-| Elm-side conveniences Naive UI does not offer as props: `size` (px),
`fontWeight` (any CSS value) and `align` (`text-align`). Emitted inline so they
win over both elm-ui helper classes and the scoped Naive UI rules.
-}
convenienceStyles : Options msg -> List ( String, String )
convenienceStyles opts =
    List.concat
        [ maybeStyle "font-size" (Maybe.map (\px -> String.fromInt px ++ "px") opts.size)
        , maybeStyle "font-weight" opts.fontWeight
        , maybeStyle "text-align" (Maybe.map alignCss opts.align)
        ]


maybeStyle : String -> Maybe String -> List ( String, String )
maybeStyle prop value =
    case value of
        Just v ->
            [ ( prop, v ) ]

        Nothing ->
            []


alignCss : FontAlign -> String
alignCss align =
    case align of
        AlignLeft ->
            "left"

        AlignCenter ->
            "center"

        AlignRight ->
            "right"

        AlignJustify ->
            "justify"

module NUI.Internal exposing (classIf, classes, cssVars)

{-| Small shared helpers used by every component.

Naive UI styles every component from two inputs:

1.  BEM class names on the element (`.n-button.n-button--primary`), which carry the
    static structure rules from `css/naive-ui.css`.
2.  `--n-*` CSS custom properties, which carry the themed values. Naive UI emits
    these as an inline `style` attribute; so do we.

Both are attached to elm-ui elements via `Element.htmlAttribute`.

-}

import Element exposing (Attribute)
import Html.Attributes as HA


{-| `classIf True "x" == [ "x" ]`, `classIf False "x" == []`. Compose a class list
with `List.concat`.
-}
classIf : Bool -> String -> List String
classIf cond c =
    if cond then
        [ c ]

    else
        []


classes : List String -> Attribute msg
classes =
    Element.htmlAttribute << HA.class << String.join " "


{-| Attach an inline `style` attribute built from `--n-*` custom properties.
`initial` values (Naive UI's "unset" marker) are dropped.
-}
cssVars : List ( String, String ) -> Attribute msg
cssVars vars =
    Element.htmlAttribute (HA.attribute "style" (renderVars vars))


renderVars : List ( String, String ) -> String
renderVars vars =
    vars
        |> List.filter (\( _, v ) -> v /= "initial" && not (String.isEmpty v))
        |> List.map (\( k, v ) -> k ++ ":" ++ v)
        |> String.join ";"
